title: "Build Taxonomic Context Figures"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: false
editor: source
execute:
  enabled: false
---

This notebook rebuilds the two taxonomy-tree structures used in the original
poster with current, manuscript-eligible inputs. The MAG figure uses the complete
post-model MAG interpretation rather than the retired subset-first expression
analysis and adds a metagenomic family-level community profile. The viral panel
uses an explicit current-catalogue filter and makes no treatment or host-phage
inference.

Run individual lines or the analysis chunk for inline debugging. For exact
command-line behaviour, including the optional output directory, use:

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/build_taxonomic_context_figures.qmd [output-directory]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this notebook updates
the canonical manuscript-candidate directory.

```{r}
#| label: build-taxonomic-context-figures
#| echo: true
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ape)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggtree)
  library(ggnewscale)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})

abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

repo_root <- function() {
  root <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "R", "figure_style.R"))) {
    abort("Run this notebook from the phage_uv_ecology_analysis repository root")
  }
  root
}

promote_file <- function(source, destination) {
  dir.create(dirname(destination), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  incoming <- paste0(destination, ".incoming-", Sys.getpid())
  if (!file.copy(source, incoming, overwrite = TRUE, copy.mode = TRUE)) {
    abort("Failed to stage %s for promotion", basename(destination))
  }
  if (!file.rename(incoming, destination)) {
    unlink(incoming)
    abort("Failed to promote %s", basename(destination))
  }
}

newick_label <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "_", as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("^_+|_+$", "", x)
  ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "", "unknown", x)
}

taxonomy_newick <- function(x, id_col, rank_cols, root_label) {
  children <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

  add_child <- function(parent, child) {
    current <- if (exists(parent, envir = children, inherits = FALSE)) {
      get(parent, envir = children, inherits = FALSE)
    } else {
      character()
    }
    if (!(child %chin% current)) {
      assign(parent, sort(c(current, child)), envir = children)
    }
  }

  root_key <- newick_label(root_label)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
    parent <- root_key
    lineage <- unlist(x[i, ..rank_cols], use.names = FALSE)
    lineage <- lineage[!is.na(lineage) & nzchar(lineage)]
    for (taxon in lineage) {
      child <- paste(parent, newick_label(taxon), sep = "|")
      add_child(parent, child)
      parent <- child
    }
    add_child(parent, newick_label(x[[id_col]][[i]]))
  }

  to_newick <- function(node) {
    kids <- if (exists(node, envir = children, inherits = FALSE)) {
      get(node, envir = children, inherits = FALSE)
    } else {
      character()
    }
    label <- newick_label(sub(".*[|]", "", node))
    if (!length(kids)) return(label)
    paste0("(", paste(vapply(kids, to_newick, character(1)), collapse = ","), ")", label)
  }

  paste0(to_newick(root_key), ";")
}

extract_prefixed_rank <- function(lineage, prefix) {
  vapply(strsplit(as.character(lineage), ";", fixed = TRUE), function(parts) {
    hit <- parts[startsWith(parts, prefix)]
    if (!length(hit)) return(NA_character_)
    sub(paste0("^", prefix), "", hit[[1L]])
  }, character(1))
}

deepest_taxon <- function(x, columns) {
  answer <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(x))
  for (column in columns) {
    take <- is.na(answer) | !nzchar(answer)
    values <- as.character(x[[column]])
    answer[take & !is.na(values) & nzchar(values)] <- values[take & !is.na(values) & nzchar(values)]
  }
  answer
}

write_checksums <- function(output_dir, staging) {
  checksum_path <- file.path(output_dir, "output_checksums.md5.tsv")
  files <- list.files(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, all.files = FALSE)
  files <- files[file.info(files)$isdir %in% FALSE & normalizePath(files) != normalizePath(checksum_path)]
  files <- sort(files)
  checksum_table <- data.table(
    path = sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(output_dir), "/?"), "", normalizePath(files)),
    bytes = file.info(files)$size,
    md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(files))
  )
  checksum_stage <- file.path(staging, "output_checksums.md5.tsv")
  fwrite(checksum_table, checksum_stage, sep = "\t")
  promote_file(checksum_stage, checksum_path)
}

build_taxonomic_context <- function(root, output_dir) {
  project_data <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"
  paths <- list(
    quality = file.path(project_data, "binning", "dereplication", "data_tables", "Widb.csv"),
    taxonomy = file.path(project_data, "annotation", "catbat", "gtdb", "BAT.bin2classification.txt"),
    coherence = file.path(project_data, "derived", "full_de_interpretation", "tables", "mag_coherence.tsv"),
    mag_mg_counts = file.path(project_data, "quantification", "mags_votu", "coverage", "metagenomics", "coverm", "output-Read_Count.tsv"),
    sample_metadata = file.path(root, "metadata", "sample_metadata.tsv"),
    checkv = file.path(project_data, "viromics", "annotation", "PRJEB79569_vOTUs", "vclust_catalogue", "checkv", "quality_summary.tsv"),
    cenote = file.path(project_data, "viromics", "annotation", "PRJEB79569_vOTUs", "vclust_catalogue", "cenotetaker3", "output", "output_virus_summary.tsv"),
    clusters = file.path(project_data, "viromics", "votu_clustering", "cluster_summary.tsv"),
    registry = file.path(output_dir, "candidate_figure_registry.tsv")
  )
  missing <- names(paths)[!file.exists(unlist(paths))]
  if (length(missing)) abort("Missing inputs: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

  source(file.path(root, "R", "figure_style.R"))

  staging <- file.path(dirname(output_dir), sprintf(".taxonomic-context-staging-%s", Sys.getpid()))
  dir.create(file.path(staging, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(staging, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(staging, "trees"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  on.exit(if (dir.exists(staging)) unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  quality <- fread(paths$quality)
  quality[, MAG_ID := sub("[.]fasta$", "", genome)]
  if (nrow(quality) != 348L || uniqueN(quality$MAG_ID) != 348L) {
    abort("Expected 348 unique MAG quality records")
  }

  taxonomy <- fread(paths$taxonomy)
  setnames(taxonomy, "# bin", "MAG_ID")
  taxonomy[, MAG_ID := sub("[.]fasta$", "", MAG_ID)]
  rank_prefixes <- c(
    domain = "d__", phylum = "p__", class = "c__", order = "o__",
    family = "f__", genus = "g__", species = "s__"
  )
  for (rank in names(rank_prefixes)) {
    taxonomy[, (rank) := extract_prefixed_rank(lineage, rank_prefixes[[rank]])]
  }
  if (nrow(taxonomy) != 348L || uniqueN(taxonomy$MAG_ID) != 348L) {
    abort("Expected 348 unique MAG taxonomy records")
  }

  coherence <- fread(paths$coherence)[coefficient == "condition_adjusted"]
  if (nrow(coherence) != 340L || sum(coherence$FDR < 0.05) != 175L) {
    abort("Adjusted-condition MAG interpretation is not the verified 340-MAG, 175-supported result")
  }

  mag <- merge(
    quality[, .(
      MAG_ID, completeness, contamination, strain_heterogeneity, size, N50,
      completeness_metric, contamination_metric
    )],
    taxonomy[, c("MAG_ID", names(rank_prefixes)), with = FALSE],
    by = "MAG_ID",
    all = TRUE
  )
  mag <- merge(
    mag,
    coherence[, .(
      MAG_ID, eligible, Direction, FDR, median_logFC,
      recurrent_treatment_higher_genes, recurrent_control_higher_genes,
      n_tested_genes
    )],
    by = "MAG_ID",
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  mag[is.na(eligible), eligible := FALSE]
  mag[, de_state := fcase(
    !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05 & Direction == "Up", "Phage-UV higher",
    !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05 & Direction == "Down", "Control higher",
    !is.na(FDR), "Not supported",
    default = "Not modeled"
  )]
  mag[, recurrence_balance := fifelse(
    !is.na(n_tested_genes) & n_tested_genes > 0,
    (recurrent_treatment_higher_genes - recurrent_control_higher_genes) / n_tested_genes,
    NA_real_
  )]
  mag[, deepest_taxon := deepest_taxon(.SD, c("species", "genus", "family", "order", "class", "phylum", "domain"))]
  mag[, phylum_display := fifelse(
    is.na(phylum) | !nzchar(phylum), "Unclassified",
    fifelse(phylum %chin% names(phage_uv_phylum_colours), phylum, "Other")
  )]
  setorder(mag, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species, MAG_ID, na.last = TRUE)

  mag_newick <- taxonomy_newick(
    mag,
    id_col = "MAG_ID",
    rank_cols = names(rank_prefixes),
    root_label = "Cellular_organisms"
  )
  mag_tree_path <- file.path(staging, "trees", "mag_taxonomic_context.nwk")
  writeLines(mag_newick, mag_tree_path)
  mag_tree <- read.tree(text = mag_newick)
  if (Ntip(mag_tree) != 348L || !setequal(mag_tree$tip.label, mag$MAG_ID)) {
    abort("MAG taxonomy tree does not contain the expected 348 tips")
  }

  mag_tip <- data.frame(label = mag$MAG_ID, as.data.frame(mag), check.names = FALSE)
  p_mag <- ggtree(mag_tree, layout = "circular", branch.length = "none", linewidth = 0.18, colour = "#B7B7B7")
  positions <- as.data.table(p_mag$data[p_mag$data$isTip, c("label", "x", "y")])
  setnames(positions, "label", "MAG_ID")
  positions <- merge(positions, mag, by = "MAG_ID", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  radius <- max(p_mag$data$x, na.rm = TRUE)
  ring_x <- radius + c(0.30, 0.62, 0.94, 1.26)
  recurrence_limit <- max(abs(quantile(positions$recurrence_balance, c(0.02, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE)))
  recurrence_limit <- max(recurrence_limit, 0.05)

  de_colours <- c(
    "Control higher" = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],
    "Phage-UV higher" = phage_uv_condition_colours[["phage_uv"]],
    "Not supported" = "#D8D8D8",
    "Not modeled" = "#FFFFFF"
  )
  phylum_levels <- intersect(names(phage_uv_phylum_colours), unique(positions$phylum_display))
  p_mag <- p_mag +
    geom_point(
      data = positions,
      aes(x = x, y = y, colour = factor(phylum_display, levels = phylum_levels)),
      size = 0.85,
      alpha = 0.95,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = phage_uv_phylum_colours,
      drop = TRUE,
      name = "Phylum",
      guide = guide_legend(order = 1)
    ) +
    geom_tile(
      data = positions,
      aes(x = ring_x[[1L]], y = y, fill = completeness),
      width = 0.25,
      height = 0.92,
      colour = NA,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#F7FBFF",
      high = "#08519C",
      limits = c(75, 100),
      name = "Completeness (%)",
      guide = guide_colourbar(order = 2)
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_tile(
      data = positions,
      aes(x = ring_x[[2L]], y = y, fill = contamination),
      width = 0.25,
      height = 0.92,
      colour = NA,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#FFF5F0",
      high = "#A50F15",
      limits = c(0, 25),
      name = "Contamination (%)",
      guide = guide_colourbar(order = 3)
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_tile(
      data = positions,
      aes(x = ring_x[[3L]], y = y, fill = de_state),
      width = 0.25,
      height = 0.92,
      colour = NA,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = de_colours,
      name = "Adjusted membrane\ncoherence",
      guide = guide_legend(order = 4)
    ) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_tile(
      data = positions,
      aes(x = ring_x[[4L]], y = y, fill = recurrence_balance),
      width = 0.25,
      height = 0.92,
      colour = NA,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],
      mid = "#F7F7F7",
      high = phage_uv_condition_colours[["phage_uv"]],
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-recurrence_limit, recurrence_limit),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = "Recurrent-gene\nbalance",
      guide = guide_colourbar(order = 5)
    ) +
    xlim(0, ring_x[[4L]] + 1.25) +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.36, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6.4),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7.1),
      plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12)
    )

  mag_counts <- fread(paths$mag_mg_counts)
  mag_counts <- mag_counts[grepl("_MAGScoT_", Contig, fixed = TRUE)]
  mag_counts[, MAG_ID := vapply(
    strsplit(Contig, "_", fixed = TRUE),
    function(parts) paste(parts[seq_len(4L)], collapse = "_"),
    character(1)
  )]
  count_columns <- setdiff(names(mag_counts), c("Contig", "MAG_ID"))
  mag_sample_counts <- mag_counts[, lapply(.SD, sum, na.rm = TRUE), by = MAG_ID, .SDcols = count_columns]
  mag_sample_counts <- melt(
    mag_sample_counts,
    id.vars = "MAG_ID",
    variable.name = "source_sample",
    value.name = "reads"
  )
  mag_sample_counts[, metagenome_run_accession := sub(
    ".*(ERR[0-9]+).*", "\\1", source_sample
  )]
  sample_metadata <- fread(paths$sample_metadata)
  sample_metadata <- sample_metadata[, .(
    sample_title, condition, phase, cycle, metagenome_run_accession
  )]
  mag_sample_counts <- merge(
    mag_sample_counts,
    sample_metadata,
    by = "metagenome_run_accession",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  if (anyNA(mag_sample_counts$sample_title) || uniqueN(mag_sample_counts$sample_title) != 12L) {
    abort("MAG metagenomic counts do not map uniquely to the 12 physical samples")
  }
  mag_sample_counts <- merge(
    mag_sample_counts,
    mag[, .(MAG_ID, family)],
    by = "MAG_ID",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  mag_sample_counts[is.na(family) | !nzchar(family), family := "Unclassified"]
  unclassified_family_label <- "Unclassified at family level"
  other_family_label <- "Other classified families"
  fixed_families <- setdiff(
    names(phage_uv_family_colours),
    c(unclassified_family_label, other_family_label)
  )
  mag_sample_counts[, family_display := fifelse(
    family == "Unclassified", unclassified_family_label,
    fifelse(family %chin% fixed_families, family, other_family_label)
  )]
  family_profile <- mag_sample_counts[, .(reads = sum(reads)), by = .(
    sample_title, condition, phase, cycle, family_display
  )]
  family_profile[, relative_abundance := reads / sum(reads), by = sample_title]
  family_levels <- names(phage_uv_family_colours)
  profile_grid <- CJ(
    sample_title = unique(sample_metadata$sample_title),
    family_display = family_levels,
    unique = TRUE
  )
  family_profile <- merge(
    profile_grid,
    family_profile,
    by = c("sample_title", "family_display"),
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  family_profile[is.na(reads), `:=`(reads = 0, relative_abundance = 0)]
  family_profile <- merge(
    family_profile,
    sample_metadata[, .(sample_title, condition, phase, cycle)],
    by = "sample_title",
    all.x = TRUE,
    suffixes = c("", ".metadata"),
    sort = FALSE
  )
  for (column in c("condition", "phase", "cycle")) {
    metadata_column <- paste0(column, ".metadata")
    family_profile[is.na(get(column)), (column) := get(metadata_column)]
    family_profile[, (metadata_column) := NULL]
  }
  family_profile[, family_display := factor(family_display, levels = family_levels)]
  family_profile[, condition_label := factor(
    condition,
    levels = c("control", "treatment"),
    labels = c("Control", "Phage-UV")
  )]
  sample_levels <- as.vector(t(outer(
    paste0("C", 1:3), c("I", "B"), paste, sep = "-"
  )))
  family_profile[, sample_label := factor(
    sprintf("C%d-%s", cycle, fifelse(phase == "initial", "I", "B")),
    levels = sample_levels
  )]

  p_family <- ggplot(
    family_profile,
    aes(x = sample_label, y = relative_abundance, fill = family_display)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.82, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.08) +
    facet_grid(condition_label ~ ., scales = "fixed") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = phage_uv_family_colours,
      breaks = family_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Family"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Cycle-phase sample", y = "Relative abundance among MAG-mapped reads") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6.2),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.7, "lines")
    )

  p_mag_combined <- p_mag + p_family +
    plot_layout(widths = c(2.2, 1.15)) +
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "plain", size = 11))

  mag_figure_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "mag-taxonomic-context.pdf")
  ggsave(mag_figure_path, p_mag_combined, width = 18, height = 10.5, device = grDevices::pdf)

  mag_summary <- mag[, .(
    MAGs = .N,
    supported_MAGs = sum(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    phage_uv_higher_MAGs = sum(FDR < 0.05 & Direction == "Up", na.rm = TRUE),
    control_higher_MAGs = sum(FDR < 0.05 & Direction == "Down", na.rm = TRUE),
    median_completeness = median(completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_contamination = median(contamination, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = .(phylum_display)][order(-MAGs, phylum_display)]
  fwrite(mag, file.path(staging, "tables", "mag_taxonomic_context.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(mag_summary, file.path(staging, "tables", "mag_taxonomic_context_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(
    family_profile[, .(
      sample_title, condition, phase, cycle, sample_label,
      family_display, reads, relative_abundance
    )],
    file.path(staging, "tables", "mag_family_community_profile.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  fwrite(
    data.table(family_display = family_levels, colour = unname(phage_uv_family_colours)),
    file.path(staging, "tables", "mag_family_colour_key.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  fwrite(
    data.table(
      panel = c("A", "A", "A", "A", "A", "B"),
      element = c(
        "phylum tip point", "completeness", "contamination",
        "adjusted membrane coherence", "recurrent-gene balance",
        "family-level metagenomic community profile; control above phage-UV with aligned cycle-phase positions"
      ),
      radial_order = c(0L, 1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, NA_integer_)
    ),
    file.path(staging, "tables", "mag_taxonomic_context_layout.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  checkv <- fread(paths$checkv, select = c(
    "contig_id", "contig_length", "gene_count", "viral_genes", "host_genes",
    "checkv_quality", "miuvig_quality", "completeness", "contamination"
  ))
  cenote <- fread(paths$cenote, select = c(
    "input_name", "organism", "virus_seq_length", "virion_hallmark_count",
    "rep_hallmark_count", "RDRP_hallmark_count", "taxonomy_hierarchy"
  ))
  setnames(cenote, "input_name", "contig_id")
  clusters <- fread(paths$clusters, select = c("representative", "n_members", "sources"))

  votu <- merge(cenote, checkv, by = "contig_id", all.x = TRUE)
  votu <- merge(votu, clusters, by.x = "contig_id", by.y = "representative", all.x = TRUE)
  setorder(votu, contig_id, -virus_seq_length, taxonomy_hierarchy, na.last = TRUE)
  votu <- votu[, .SD[1L], by = contig_id]
  votu[, n_members := fifelse(is.na(n_members), 1L, n_members)]
  votu[, has_taxonomy := !is.na(taxonomy_hierarchy) & nzchar(taxonomy_hierarchy)]
  votu[, passes_current_filter :=
    miuvig_quality == "High-quality" & viral_genes > 0 & has_taxonomy]
  votu_filtered <- votu[passes_current_filter == TRUE]
  if (nrow(votu_filtered) != 607L || uniqueN(votu_filtered$contig_id) != 607L) {
    abort("Expected 607 unique vOTUs under the declared current-catalogue filter")
  }

  viral_ranks <- c("domain", "realm", "kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family", "subfamily", "genus", "species")
  viral_prefixes <- c(
    kingdom = "k_", phylum = "p_", class = "c_", order = "o_",
    family = "f_", subfamily = "sf_", genus = "g_", species = "s_"
  )
  votu_filtered[, domain := vapply(strsplit(taxonomy_hierarchy, ";", fixed = TRUE), function(parts) {
    if (!length(parts)) return(NA_character_)
    sub("^-_", "", parts[[1L]])
  }, character(1))]
  votu_filtered[, realm := vapply(strsplit(taxonomy_hierarchy, ";", fixed = TRUE), function(parts) {
    hit <- parts[startsWith(parts, "-_")]
    if (length(hit) < 2L) return("Unclassified")
    sub("^-_", "", hit[[2L]])
  }, character(1))]
  for (rank in names(viral_prefixes)) {
    votu_filtered[, (rank) := extract_prefixed_rank(taxonomy_hierarchy, viral_prefixes[[rank]])]
  }
  votu_filtered[is.na(domain) | !nzchar(domain), domain := "Unclassified"]
  votu_filtered[is.na(realm) | !nzchar(realm), realm := "Unclassified"]

  votu_groups <- votu_filtered[, .(
    n_votus = .N,
    n_cluster_members = sum(n_members, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_length = median(contig_length, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_completeness = median(completeness, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = c("taxonomy_hierarchy", viral_ranks)][order(-n_votus, taxonomy_hierarchy)]
  votu_groups[, vOTU_group := sprintf("vOTU_group_%03d", seq_len(.N))]
  votu_groups[, deepest_taxon := deepest_taxon(.SD, rev(viral_ranks))]
  votu_groups[, display_label := sprintf("%s (n=%s)", deepest_taxon, n_votus)]
  votu_groups[, realm_display := fifelse(
    realm %chin% names(phage_uv_viral_realm_colours),
    realm,
    "Unclassified"
  )]

  votu_newick <- taxonomy_newick(
    votu_groups,
    id_col = "vOTU_group",
    rank_cols = viral_ranks,
    root_label = "Viruses"
  )
  votu_tree_path <- file.path(staging, "trees", "votu_taxonomic_context.nwk")
  writeLines(votu_newick, votu_tree_path)
  votu_tree <- read.tree(text = votu_newick)
  if (Ntip(votu_tree) != nrow(votu_groups)) {
    abort("vOTU taxonomy tree tip count does not match the grouped catalogue")
  }

  label_ids <- head(votu_groups[order(-n_votus, display_label)]$vOTU_group, 18L)
  votu_tip <- data.frame(label = votu_groups$vOTU_group, as.data.frame(votu_groups), check.names = FALSE)
  votu_tip$tree_label <- ifelse(votu_tip$vOTU_group %in% label_ids, votu_tip$display_label, "")

  p_votu_tree <- ggtree(votu_tree, layout = "daylight", branch.length = "none", linewidth = 0.25, colour = "#8A8A8A") %<+% votu_tip +
    geom_tippoint(aes(size = n_votus, colour = realm_display), alpha = 0.92) +
    geom_tiplab(aes(label = tree_label), size = 2.05, offset = 0.15, linesize = 0.15) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = phage_uv_viral_realm_colours, name = "Realm") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.6, 7.5), name = "vOTUs") +
    labs(tag = "A") +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.margin = margin(55, 75, 65, 75)
    )

  votu_filtered[, realm_display := fifelse(
    realm %chin% names(phage_uv_viral_realm_colours),
    realm,
    "Unclassified"
  )]
  realm_summary <- votu_filtered[, .(
    n_votus = .N,
    n_cluster_members = sum(n_members, na.rm = TRUE),
    taxonomy_groups = uniqueN(taxonomy_hierarchy)
  ), by = .(realm_display)][order(n_votus)]
  p_realm <- ggplot(realm_summary, aes(
    x = n_votus,
    y = reorder(realm_display, n_votus),
    fill = realm_display
  )) +
    geom_col(width = 0.68, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.18) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_votus), hjust = -0.18, size = 2.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = phage_uv_viral_realm_colours, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.16))) +
    labs(x = "High-quality vOTUs", y = NULL, tag = "B") +
    theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.2) +
    theme(
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )

  p_votu <- p_votu_tree | p_realm + plot_layout(widths = c(2.15, 0.85))
  votu_figure_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "votu-taxonomic-context.pdf")
  ggsave(votu_figure_path, p_votu, width = 14, height = 9, device = grDevices::pdf)

  filter_summary <- data.table(
    criterion = c(
      "catalogue_rows", "miuvig_high_quality", "high_quality_with_taxonomy",
      "high_quality_with_taxonomy_and_viral_genes", "taxonomy_groups"
    ),
    value = c(
      nrow(votu),
      votu[miuvig_quality == "High-quality", .N],
      votu[miuvig_quality == "High-quality" & has_taxonomy == TRUE, .N],
      nrow(votu_filtered),
      nrow(votu_groups)
    )
  )
  fwrite(votu_groups, file.path(staging, "tables", "votu_taxonomic_context_groups.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(realm_summary, file.path(staging, "tables", "votu_taxonomic_context_realm_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  fwrite(filter_summary, file.path(staging, "tables", "votu_taxonomic_context_filter_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")

  figure_paths <- c(mag_figure_path, votu_figure_path)
  if (any(!file.exists(figure_paths)) || any(file.info(figure_paths)$size == 0L)) {
    abort("One or more taxonomic-context PDFs were not rendered")
  }

  generated <- list.files(staging, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  generated <- generated[file.info(generated)$isdir %in% FALSE]
  generated <- generated[!basename(generated) %chin% c("candidate_figure_registry.tsv", "output_checksums.md5.tsv")]
  for (source_path in generated) {
    relative <- sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(staging), "/?"), "", normalizePath(source_path))
    promote_file(source_path, file.path(output_dir, relative))
  }

  registry <- fread(paths$registry)
  additions <- data.table(
    artifact = c("mag-taxonomic-context.pdf", "votu-taxonomic-context.pdf"),
    status = "candidate_unallocated",
    panels = c(
      "348-MAG taxonomic dendrogram with completeness and contamination first; adjusted membrane coherence; recurrent-gene balance; family-level metagenomic community profile",
      "current high-quality vOTU taxonomy cladogram; realm-level catalogue composition"
    ),
    boundary = c(
      "Taxonomy-derived, not a sequence phylogeny; complete-universe post-model MAG results; membrane identity remains confounded with condition",
      "Taxonomy-derived, not a sequence phylogeny; current descriptive catalogue only; no treatment or host-phage inference"
    )
  )
  registry <- rbindlist(list(registry[!artifact %chin% additions$artifact], additions), use.names = TRUE)
  registry_stage <- file.path(staging, "candidate_figure_registry.tsv")
  fwrite(registry, registry_stage, sep = "\t")
  promote_file(registry_stage, paths$registry)
  write_checksums(output_dir, staging)

  cat(sprintf("Created two unallocated taxonomic-context candidates in %s\n", output_dir))
}

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
root <- repo_root()
output_dir <- if (length(args)) args[[1L]] else file.path(
  "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569",
  "derived",
  "manuscript_figure_candidates"
)
build_taxonomic_context(root, output_dir)
```
